mapper.select: SELECT o.ICATE_NO, o.OWNER_TY, o.OWNER_ID, o.INHERIT_YN, o.SINS_DT, o.SINS_ID, CASE o.OWNER_TY WHEN 'DEPT' THEN (SELECT g.ORGNZT_NM FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO g WHERE g.ORGNZT_ID = o.OWNER_ID) WHEN 'USER' THEN (SELECT u.USER_NM FROM COMVNUSERMASTER u WHERE u.ESNTL_ID = o.OWNER_ID) END AS OWNER_NM, (SELECT c.SNAME FROM TB_CATE c WHERE c.ICATE_NO = o.ICATE_NO) AS CATE_NM FROM TB_CATE_OWNER o WHERE o.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} ORDER BY o.OWNER_TY, OWNER_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CATE_OWNER (ICATE_NO, OWNER_TY, OWNER_ID, INHERIT_YN, SINS_DT, SINS_ID) VALUES ( #{cateNo}, #{ownerTy}, #{ownerId}, NVL(#{inheritYn}, 'Y'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{insId} )
mapper.select: SELECT ORGNZT_ID AS "orgnztId", ORGNZT_NM AS "orgnztNm" FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO ORDER BY ORGNZT_NM

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CATE_OWNER o WHERE ( ( o.OWNER_TY = 'USER' AND o.OWNER_ID = #{esntlId} ) OR ( o.OWNER_TY = 'DEPT' AND o.OWNER_ID = #{orgnztId} ) ) AND o.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT a.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE a START WITH a.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} CONNECT BY PRIOR a.IREF = a.ICATE_NO ) AND ( o.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} OR o.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CATE_OWNER o WHERE o.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT a.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE a START WITH a.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} CONNECT BY PRIOR a.IREF = a.ICATE_NO ) AND ( o.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} OR o.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' )
